invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null List, as a List is constructed using stream.collect() even if it could be empty.
Only non-null HoodieRecord<T> are included in the returned list, due to filter(Objects::nonNull).
After deduplication, the output list cannot have more elements than the input list.
schemaStr is used to create a HoodieSchema via HoodieSchema.parse(schemaStr); it must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
orderingFieldNames is passed to the reduceRecords call and expected to be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
